name: Camping/Wohnmobilstellplatz Hotel Krimmlerfälle
beschreibung: The campsite and motorhome pitch listed in the dataset belongs to the Hotel Krimmlerfälle and is located near the village of Krimml, close to the famous Krimml Waterfalls. The entry mentions pitches for motorhomes and tents with electricity connections as well as modern, clean sanitary facilities. Guests can reach the waterfalls and hiking trails; a restaurant in the hotel provides meals. The surroundings are suitable for nature lovers and hikers, and the site is ideal for short stays to visit the national park. Important: Krimml is located in the Salzburg Pinzgau on the edge of the Hohe Tauern National Park and therefore not in Tyrol. A clear assignment to the federal state of Tyrol is therefore not possible.
kurzbeschreibung: Campsite and motorhome pitch of Hotel Krimmlerfälle near the Krimml Waterfalls; located in the Salzburg Pinzgau, not in Tyrol.
